questions: Have you been experiencing episodes of seizures or loss of consciousness that brought you in for this EEG monitoring?
During these episodes, do you lose awareness of your surroundings or are you aware but unable to respond?
Have you experienced generalized tonic-clonic seizures (shaking of all four limbs, tongue biting, or urinary incontinence)?
Have you had any recent head trauma, brain surgery, or neurological infections (meningitis/encephalitis)?
Is there a family history of epilepsy or seizure disorders?
Are your seizures typically triggered by specific stimuli such as flashing lights, emotional stress, sleep deprivation, or loud noises?
orders: Serum electrolytes, calcium, magnesium, and glucose level to rule out metabolic causes.
MRI of the brain to rule out structural lesions.
EEG telemetry review during the 17-second observation to assess for interictal epileptiform discharges and correlate with seizure semiology.
served: video-EEG monitoring of a typical event
